summary: Habit tracking app with monthly volume/totals and habit editing UI.
architectural_notes: Differentiate habit types: reps/time-based vs tick/checkbox-based; monthly totals for checkbox habits are computed as count of selected ticks (+1 per tick) and displayed alongside monthly volume/goal area.

existing_features.title: Update monthly total calculations and display for habits whose unit type is neither "reps" nor "time": the monthly total must equal the number of selected day checkboxes (each checked day counts as +1), and the UI must show both the monthly total and the goal in the existing monthly totals/volumes area for the habit row.

Ensure the "16/8 fasting" habit follows the non-(reps/time) monthly total behavior: monthly total increments by 1 per checked day and displays the goal alongside the monthly total in the existing monthly totals/volumes area.

Revise the habit editing UI so edit controls are not visible on the main grid: remove the always/hover-visible inline edit buttons for name/unit/volume from the habit row, and instead make clicking/tapping a habit open a small pop-up with a single edit-pen action; selecting the pen must open a full habit edit modal that allows changing all habit details currently editable in the app (including name, unit type, and the selected month’s volume/goal).

new_feature_requests.summary: For non-reps/time habits (e.g., 16/8 fasting), count each tick box selection as +1 and show the monthly total/goal in the existing monthly volumes area.
Revise habit edit UI so edit options are hidden on the main screen; tapping a habit shows a single edit-pen popup/icon, which then opens the full habit edit screen.

projectName: Count monthly totals for non reps/time habits and simplify habit editing UI
